method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (cla-core.l4) with two regulative rules (s 25; s 70(4)) run by EVALTRACE inside functions that take only plain facts; one seat layer (the claimant) that restates no rule; answers are named outcomes or numbers, no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Both from the Open Australian Legal Corpus (South Australian legislation last collected 2025-03-10), not the official texts, and possibly out of date: Civil Liability Act 1936, corpus document south_australian_legislation:2023-06-22/1936.2267.un, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/civil-liability-act-1936.txt (sha256 2f71d9df35fbc33f6d99350d46b95f1dc07a7b745aeb874d78e3ac7b0a7fb254); Civil Liability Regulations 2013, corpus document south_australian_legislation:2015-10-02/2013.165.un, as deposited at subjects/au/sa/civil-liability-regulations-2013/registers/source-bundle/civil-liability-regulations-2013.txt (sha256 2ff7cb8cf670fb4a9cf0c71ea71952bc06266cc31be5f6fee810fc83445a4015), regs 7, 18 and 19. Parts 6-8 for accidents on or after 1 May 2004; the MVA rules for MVA motor accidents on or after 1 July 2013. CPI figures, State average weekly earnings, the superannuation rate and scale values are inputs.

checks.result: 178 assertions written, 178 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a negative control (s 52(3)(c)(ii) $3 000 to $3 001, s 49 age 16 to 17) failed exactly the 3 predicted assertions and was reverted

scope: In: Part 5 (ss 23-30); Part 6 Div 3 (ss 36-39) and Div 6 (s 43); Part 7 (ss 44-50); Part 8 (ss 51-58B); Part 9 ss 65, 67, 70, 74, 75; Regulations regs 7, 18, 19. Out: Parts 3 and 4, Part 6 Divs 1, 2, 4 and s 33 (directions to the court's negligence judgment); s 42 (road authorities, second pass); Parts 7A and 7B (institutional child abuse, its own layer); the rest of Part 9 and s 66; s 76 and Regulations Parts 2 and 4 and Schedule 1 (the ISV is an input).
